full_text:
Unnamed Suit 050 is a Suit working for the Organization, previously commanded by Rassimov.

== History ==
This Suit travelled to Ethiopia with Rassimov and the Professor. [The Golden Asp] She attempted to ambush the Huntik team in King Solomon's mines but failed. A Clonemask of her face was used by Zhalia Moon to impersonate and lead the Professor into another room to give Lok Lambert and Sophie Casterwill time open the vault and find the Ring of Tao. [To Be Together]
== Abilities ==
Like most Suits, she was issued with the standard Organization Titans and spells.

===Spells Utilized===
*Augerfrost
